press_references.value: ITAT rules Cloudera Inc's software subscription revenue not taxable as royalty

legal_proceedings.description: The New Delhi bench of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal partly allowed Cloudera Inc.'s appeals for AY 2020-21 to 2022-23, ruling that about Rs 56.63 crore of software subscription revenue from Indian customers is not taxable in India as royalty or fees for technical services, while holding that Rs 3.05 crore of professional services fees in AY 2022-23 constitutes taxable fees for technical services under Indian law and the India-U.S. tax treaty, taxable at 10%. The tribunal also ordered a refund of the proportionate equalisation levy and related surcharge, cess, and interest.

about_short_description.short_description: Cloudera is a software development company that offers data management and cloud-native data analytic solutions.

product.name: Cloudera Data Platform
product.description: A hybrid data management and analytics platform for running data and AI workloads across public clouds, on-premises data centers, and edge environments.

product.name: Cloudera Open Data Lakehouse
product.description: An Apache Iceberg-powered data lakehouse for storing, processing, governing, and analyzing data across hybrid environments.

product.name: Cloudera Enterprise AI
product.description: A platform for developing, deploying, and managing machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI applications on governed enterprise data.

product.name: Cloudera Unified Data Fabric
product.description: A data management architecture that connects distributed data sources and centralizes security, governance, lineage, and control across hybrid environments.

product.name: Cloudera Data in Motion
product.description: A platform for collecting, streaming, routing, and processing real-time data from diverse sources to destinations across hybrid and edge environments.

product.name: Cloudera Data Services
product.description: Cloud-native services for building and operating data and AI applications, including data engineering, analytics, machine learning, and data warehousing.
